classification: IH2-069 candidate analytical schedules only; no runtime commands, saved accounts, grants or authority proof
method: 128 independent price/schedule/start/policy combinations. Abstract known-answer free delivery chapter completes in the first modeled visit: no walking/reading/human-duration claim. Current pine/crop/easel constants are imported; proposed box payments use separate model ledgers, never a forged current WorkshopState. No ordinary materials/job changes. Actual hamper/welcome-request choices are omitted: this is an easel-oriented strategy comparison, not a full economy optimum.
assumptions: Free Nella lesson/equipment and personal supply access are available in the modeled visit; not measured lesson/travel time.
Two radish beds and one flower bed; harvest only at a visit and only with family capacity; ready plants wait.
Pine has6supply/one per4h/carried24; gathering uses the shared personal pool; no gift/assistant material transfer.
A claimed easel may be followed by a new explicit start at the same visit. No offline auto-repeat.
Initial depleted/running/full states are hand-authored relative analytical histories, not real accounts or actual saved fixtures.
The ordinary12hjob is a protected constant, not modeled housing/production output.
Box-first versus reserve-next-easel is a voluntary modeled strategy, never a hidden player-stock lock.
The free route card/plan is separate from physical box ownership. Route-card-only never mints a box.
Three public showcase group sizes below are simple independent-owner count projections, not additional playtests, cooperation acceleration or server/privacy verification.
